title: From salon apprentice to salon owner, the career ladder explained with Ledger in 90 seconds
summary: An everyday service job viewers know from their own haircut, climbing to owning the whole salon.

beats.label: title
beats.voice: From salon apprentice to salon owner, the career ladder explained with Ledger in ninety seconds.
onScreen: From salon apprentice to salon owner, the career ladder explained with Ledger
beats.visual: Title scene: full-bleed room, a ladder on the right, the five steps below, small Ledger in the hr_apprentice outfit waving on the bottom step; a dashed arrow climbs to the top; the title card and the 90-second pill appear on the title words

beats.label: rung 1 THE APPRENTICE
beats.voice: First, Ledger is the salon apprentice, in a black apron.
beats.visual: OUTFIT (hr_apprentice: black salon apron, hair clips on the apron strap, comb behind the ear, lanyard). Header THE APPRENTICE. Ledger alone, scale 3.2; arrows pop in on 'apron' and 'comb'; a salon chair and mirror behind

beats.label: rung 1 THE APPRENTICE
beats.voice: Then he greets clients, and washes their hair.
beats.visual: A client sits; a basin fills; a broom sweeps hair into a bin

beats.label: rung 1 THE APPRENTICE
beats.voice: He watches the stylist cut, and learns simple cuts.
beats.visual: A stylist figure cuts; Ledger copies with a comb in the air

beats.label: rung 1 THE APPRENTICE
beats.voice: So on this rung, he styles under guidance.
beats.visual: Slider at 0.06 on 'Styles'

beats.label: climb 1 to 2
beats.voice: After that, he becomes a stylist.
beats.visual: Ledger climbs the ladder from rung 1 to rung 2; his outfit swaps mid-climb to the next set; the next rung tag lights up on the naming word

beats.label: rung 2 THE STYLIST
beats.voice: Now he is a stylist, and cuts and colours his own clients.
beats.visual: OUTFIT (hr_stylist: purple shirt with rolled sleeves, scissors holster, name tag). Header THE STYLIST. Ledger cuts a client's hair; a colour bowl and brush appear

beats.label: rung 2 THE STYLIST
beats.voice: Then he keeps his own book, and takes payments.
beats.visual: A column of appointments fills; a card reader beeps (the till shows euros)

beats.label: climb 2 to 3
beats.voice: Then he climbs again, to senior stylist.
beats.visual: Ledger climbs the ladder from rung 2 to rung 3; his outfit swaps mid-climb to the next set; the next rung tag lights up on the naming word

beats.label: rung 3 SENIOR STYLIST
beats.voice: As senior stylist, he teaches the team, and sets standards.
beats.visual: OUTFIT (hr_lead: teal blazer over a black tee, scissors, headset-style earpiece). Header SENIOR STYLIST. Two junior figures watch Ledger demonstrate a precise cut

beats.label: rung 3 SENIOR STYLIST
beats.voice: He also helps with hiring, and orders from the suppliers.
beats.visual: A box of products arrives; a new hire shakes his hand

beats.label: rung 3 SENIOR STYLIST
beats.voice: So he styles a little less, and starts to run.
beats.visual: Slider at 0.35; a rota on the wall

beats.label: climb 3 to 4
beats.voice: Next, he steps up as salon manager.
beats.visual: Ledger climbs the ladder from rung 3 to rung 4; his outfit swaps mid-climb to the next set; the next rung tag lights up on the naming word

beats.label: rung 4 SALON MANAGER
beats.voice: Now, as salon manager, he runs the salon day to day.
beats.visual: OUTFIT (hr_manager: charcoal waistcoat over white shirt, tablet, name plate). Header SALON MANAGER. Wide shot of the salon with four chairs and Ledger at the door

beats.label: rung 4 SALON MANAGER
beats.voice: Then he sets the rota, and controls the stock.
beats.visual: A rota fills; shelves of bottles are counted; a small owner figure nods

beats.label: climb 4 to 5
beats.voice: Finally, he reaches the top rung, as salon owner.
beats.visual: Ledger climbs the ladder from rung 4 to rung 5; his outfit swaps mid-climb to the next set; the next rung tag lights up on the naming word

beats.label: rung 5 SALON OWNER
beats.voice: Finally, as owner, he runs the business, from finances to marketing.
beats.visual: OUTFIT (hr_owner: black jacket, gold pocket square, glasses, grey temples, a salon key on a chain). Header SALON OWNER. Salon sign above the door lights up; a key is handed to Ledger

beats.label: rung 5 SALON OWNER
beats.voice: He sets prices, hires the team, and wins new clients.
beats.visual: A price board; a poster for the salon goes up in the street

beats.label: rung 5 SALON OWNER
beats.voice: Yet he styles almost no hair himself, and answers for the whole salon.
beats.visual: Slider at 0.95 on 'Runs'; every chair has a happy client

beats.label: payoff
beats.voice: So with each rung, Ledger styled less hair, and ran more of the salon.
beats.visual: Five Ledgers on the ladder, all five tags ticked, the slider runs from the bottom word to the top word

beats.label: cta
beats.voice: To climb your own career ladder, learn technical business concepts at Edlintics.

caption:
From salon apprentice to salon owner, the job changes on every rung

The apprentice washes hair and learns the first cuts, and the senior stylist cuts and colours his own clients. Then the salon manager runs the salon day to day. Finally, the owner runs the whole business, from finances to marketing

So each rung up, you style less hair yourself and run more of the salon. Walk up the ladder with Ledger and note which rung you are on

openQuestions: The 'team leader' rung is the senior stylist who teaches and helps with hiring (HJI 'Senior Stylist, Education' and 'Management' variants); the National Careers Service names only senior stylist and salon manager. Rung 2 and 3 are both senior-stylist variants, so titles could be stylist and senior stylist.
Titles vary by employer and country; the caption says nothing about pay or years
